# Draft:List of Over-the-Counter Drugs in the United Kingdom

This is a list of drugs in the United Kingdom that you can generally buy at a pharmacy or store, and do not require a prescription. Drugs that are legal but not sold medically or designer drugs are not included.
* The list is not exhaustive.
* All mentioned drugs here are generic names.
* Includes drugs from the general sales list and pharmacy medicine categories.
* Drugs in the pharmacy medicine category are denoted by (P).
* Some drugs have both prescriptions versions and over the counter versions that may differ by form or dosage.
* Also included are some common over the counter supplements, medical items, and medicinal/psychoactive plants.
A
Amylmetacresol, Acetaminophen, Aluminum chloride, Acrivastine, Alginic acid, Aluminum hydroxide, Acetylsalicylic acid, Amorolfine, Acetic acid,
B
Benzocaine, Bisacodyl, Benzoyl peroxide(P), Beclometasone, Benzydamine, Beclometasone,
